voice.title: Voice
voice.subtitle: Set how your brand sounds in drafts — tone and words to avoid.
voice.readOnly: You can view these settings. Ask a company admin if you need changes.

roast.label: Tone strength
roast.hint: Higher is sharper and more playful. Default works for most posts.

locale.label: Locale
locale.hint: Main writing locale for drafts, e.g. zh-HK.

forbidden.label: Words to avoid
forbidden.hint: Up to 15 phrases, separated by commas. Drafts will try to skip them.

tone.label: Tone notes
tone.hint: Optional. A few short lines about the feel you want.

exemplars.label: Example captions
exemplars.hint: Up to 3 short captions drafts can learn from. You can also save one after Confirm.

products.title: Products
products.subtitleOrg: Your company catalog — drafts prefer these details when talking about products.

products.readOnlyOrg: You can view the company catalog. Ask a company admin to make changes.
products.coverTitle: When both lists have the same product
products.coverBody: Drafts use the company version. Your personal copy stays for you until you ask to update the company list.

detail.title: Product details
